content.text:
The analysis is clear. During occupied hours, only the Core_bottom zone (Zone_F2_Z01) changed: its temperature dropped ~0.85C AND its cooling setpoint dropped ~0.96C (24.61→23.65C). The other core zones (F3, F4) kept both their setpoints (unmoved at 24.61→24.65C) and essentially flat temperatures.

A zone-specific setpoint shift that affects exactly one zone is characteristic of a local override or controller offset applied to that zone. A schedule change is a building/system-level construct that would shift setpoints across the core zones simultaneously — which did not happen here (F3 and F4 setpoints are unchanged).
